input.command:
ls -la "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.cursor/work-log/" 2>/dev/null; ls -la "/Users/mac/.dc-platform/memory/work-log/hosts/" 2>/dev/null; date '+%Y-%m-%d'; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day = '2026-11-19'
paths = [
  os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl'),
  os.path.expanduser('~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl'),
  os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl'),
]
for p in paths:
  print('===', p, 'exists', os.path.exists(p))
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    continue
  n=0
  with open(p, 'r', errors='ignore') as f:
    for line in f:
      if day not in line:
        continue
      try:
        o=json.loads(line)
      except Exception:
        continue
      # filter roughly
      ts = o.get('ts') or o.get('time') or o.get('created_at') or o.get('received_at') or ''
      src = o.get('source') or o.get('from') or o.get('kind') or ''
      text = (o.get('text') or o.get('summary') or o.get('payload') or '')
      if isinstance(text, dict):
        text = str(text)[:200]
      else:
        text = str(text)[:220].replace('\n',' ')
      print(f'- {ts} | {src} | {text}')
      n+=1
      if n>=40:
        print('...(cap)')
        break
  print('matched_lines~', n)
PY
input.description: List work-log and filter today provenance
